sources.title: Tight Bounds on the Spooky Pebble Game: Recycling Qubits with Measurements
sources.relevance: Studies quantum-space tradeoffs using measurements and adaptive phase correction. Our carry experiments are source-specific implementations within this established setting.

sources.title: Trade-offs between classical and quantum space using spooky pebbling
sources.relevance: Related systematic scheduling and classical/quantum storage tradeoffs. No source-level schedule from this paper has been installed here.

sources.title: Optimal (Parallel) Spooky Pebbling on Binary Trees
sources.relevance: Recent binary-tree scheduling work reports savings for different RNS point-addition implementations. Its reported percentages are not a forecast or measured improvement for our prime-field challenge circuit.
